seats.title: Board of Directors
seats.purpose: Governs the company. Does not operate it.

seats.title: Managing Director
seats.purpose: Runs the company through function heads. Still personally holds Business Development.

seats.title: National Head — Risk Operations
seats.purpose: Owns national risk operations delivery — verification, FCU-RCU and investigation — across four regions. Owns the collection number. Does not own the receivables ledger or the audit of his own quality.

seats.title: AVP — Operations & Growth
seats.purpose: All four regions report here. Also holds the Business Excellence chair reporting to the MD.

seats.title: Regional Manager
seats.purpose: Owns the West region as a business. Maharashtra, Mumbai, Goa, Gujarat and Chhattisgarh.

seats.title: Branch Manager
seats.purpose: Total accountability for the branch: business, people, books and brand.

seats.title: Team Leaders
seats.purpose: Runs the daily processing floor. Field executives report to the Branch Manager, not here.

seats.title: Back Office / Processing Executives
seats.purpose: Processes cases, prepares the report and maintains the system record.

seats.title: Branch Collection Executive
seats.purpose: Stage one of collection. Gets the bank's local officer to certify completed cases and approve the invoice, so it can move to central release. Collection starts where the relationship is.

seats.title: Business Development Executive
seats.purpose: Grows the branch book locally. Business development is a branch KPI, not only a head-office function.

seats.title: Field Executives / Verifiers
seats.purpose: Executes field verification. The evidence pack this chair produces is the product the client buys.

seats.title: Franchise Partner
seats.purpose: Independent franchise firms operating Crux-branded locations under a profit-sharing agreement. They are counterparties, not employees. Crux manages the firm, its performance and its claim — not the people inside it.

seats.title: Business Manager
seats.purpose: Runs South zone business — revenue, collections and branch performance — beneath the Regional Manager chair.

seats.title: Administration & Facilities
seats.purpose: Offices, assets, travel and admin vendors across the network.

seats.title: Credit & Collections
seats.purpose: Owns the collection number end to end and runs it as two stages. Branch executives clear local certification at the bank's own branch. Central executives then pursue release from the bank's payables desk. One target, one ageing report, one method — two teams working different stages of the same rupee.

seats.title: Central Collections Executives
seats.purpose: Stage two of collection. Once a branch has obtained local certification, this team pursues release from the client's central payables desk.

seats.title: Finance Head
seats.purpose: Owns credit policy, the ledger and the financial truth. Sets the collection target that Operations delivers, and measures DSO independently of the function collecting the money.

seats.title: Accounts
seats.purpose: Books, closing, statutory compliance and ledger integrity, including partner revenue-share settlement.

seats.title: Accounts Executives
seats.purpose: Transaction processing, reconciliation and partner share computation.

seats.title: Finance Executive
seats.purpose: Scope not yet defined. No KRA document exists for this chair.

seats.title: Assurance, Risk & Compliance
seats.purpose: Independent assurance over everything the company delivers. Reports to the MD with a direct line to the Board so a finding cannot be filtered on its way up. HR has moved out to its own function.

seats.title: Legal & Compliance
seats.purpose: Contracts, litigation and compliance, held externally today.

seats.title: Risk & Business Continuity
seats.purpose: Keeps the risk register, runs issue management, and owns what happens when something goes badly wrong.

seats.title: Head — Human Resources
seats.purpose: People as a function in its own right. Split out of the assurance chair because one person cannot hold assurance and HR at this scale and remain independent in either.

seats.title: Learning & Development
seats.purpose: Builds capability at the pace the expansion needs, and runs the internship programme.

seats.title: Interns — project based
seats.purpose: Project-based interns owned centrally, deployed to a branch or a function.

seats.title: HR Operations
seats.purpose: Operational HR across the employee lifecycle.

seats.title: Business Excellence & PMO
seats.purpose: New chair. Designs the operating system: process, projects, org design. Assurance verifies conformance to what this chair authors.

seats.title: Technology
seats.purpose: Platform, product and information security.

seats.title: Engineering & Platform
seats.purpose: Builds and runs the platform.

seats.title: MIS & Business Analytics
seats.purpose: One source of management truth. Consolidates every function into a single reporting standard.

seats.title: Business Development
seats.purpose: New client acquisition and empanelment execution. The MD formally owns the function.

seats.title: Bids, Tenders & Contracts
seats.purpose: Bid and tender pipeline through to executed agreement.

seats.title: Company Secretary
seats.purpose: Statutory and secretarial compliance. Administrative line to the MD, functional line to the Board.
